content: Beat the dealer by getting a hand total as close to 21 as possible without going over (busting).

Number cards (2-10) count as face value. Face cards (J, Q, K) count as 10. Aces count as 11 or 1.
An Ace plus any 10-value card on the initial deal is Blackjack:

- Hit: Draw another card.
- Stand: End your turn and let the dealer play.
- Double: Double your bet, draw one final card, and stand.
